**Priority Matrix 1.1.0** speaks French.

### New: French

Every button, message, label, help text and built-in theme name is now available in French, with French dates and French punctuation spacing.

- The app opens in French when your browser's first language is French.
- The **FR/EN** button next to the view buttons switches language at any time and remembers your choice on this device.
- Switching reloads the page. Your tasks, drafts and Undo history are saved first, so nothing is lost, and the button waits until you finish an open edit.

### Fixed

The **Recent** group in the theme picker kept only the theme you were on when you left the picker, so choosing several themes in a row added just the last one. Every theme you pick from the list now joins Recent, newest first.

### Get started

1. Under **Assets** below, download **Priority-Matrix-1.1.0.html**.
2. Open it in your browser. There's nothing to install, and it works without an internet connection.

You can also use it online at https://lonelysoul87.github.io/priority-matrix/ (always the latest version, so it's already up to date).

### Updating from 1.0.0

Your tasks are saved in your browser, not in the file. Before you switch, download a backup in your current copy (the download button at the top of the app). Then open 1.1.0. If your tasks aren't there, use the restore button next to it and choose that backup.

### More

[What it does](https://github.com/LonelySoul87/priority-matrix/releases/tag/v1.0.0) is described in the 1.0.0 release, and the [changelog](https://github.com/LonelySoul87/priority-matrix/blob/v1.1.0/CHANGELOG.md) lists every change. 131 automated tests run on every change. MIT license.
